name: Solar-Energy Dataset
description: A multivariate solar power production time-series benchmark used for long-term forecasting. The commonly used Solar-Energy data contains 137 photovoltaic power plant series sampled every 10 minutes; this record describes the dataset and does not distribute its files.
citation: Lai, G., Chang, W.-C., Yang, Y., and Liu, H. (2018). Modeling Long- and Short-Term Temporal Patterns with Deep Neural Networks. The 41st International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research & Development in Information Retrieval, 95–104. https://doi.org/10.1145/3209978.3210006

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms; not a standard SPDX license identifier
license.notes: The upstream repository does not clearly identify a standard SPDX license for the Solar-Energy dataset itself. Its license is not a standard SPDX identifier; review upstream terms and any source-data restrictions before use or redistribution. This record vendors no data.
